chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 feasible optimized lowest-cost candidate exists; S2 no unresolved candidates because all 15 candidates were optimized; S3 highest-activity candidate candidate_04 differs from candidate_13, and BACKWARD plus TEST_REACHABILITY were executed with classification unreachable. unresolved_decision_risk.descriptor_uncertainty_not_MC_sampled: Descriptor uncertainty distributions were read but Monte Carlo was not run; residual risk is that descriptor perturbations could alter feasibility/cost ranking. unresolved_decision_risk.edge_optima: candidate_13 optimum uses Tsep_C at the upper window edge; candidate_04 and candidate_05 use T_C at the upper edge. Results are valid within the admissible domain but could change if the domain were expanded, which is outside the task.
unresolved_decision_risk.model_floor: candidate_04 and candidate_05 bed volumes are below the vessel-correlation floor and costed with the declared clamp; this does not threaten candidate_13 because those candidates remain more expensive even with very small beds.
unresolved_decision_risk.overall: Low residual decision risk within the frozen candidate set, admissible domain, and declared cost model.
